```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r include-extended, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
src_file <- "
30-sequential-mixture-experimentation.md
"
monographs_dirs <- c(
  system.file("monographs", package = "mixRSMflow"),
  file.path("..", "inst", "monographs")
)
src <- ""
for (d in monographs_dirs) {
  candidate <- file.path(d, src_file)
  if (file.exists(candidate)) { src <- candidate; break }
}
if (nzchar(src)) {
  cat(readLines(src, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
} else {
  cat("**Extended tutorial not found.**\n")
}
```
